name: Marching Cubes with Gaussian Deformation
definition: A variant of the Marching Cubes algorithm implemented in a geometry shader that generates a triangle mesh from a scalar field defined by a sphere function, applying a Gaussian-based deformation along a user-provided force vector.
summary: Marching Cubes with Gaussian Deformation extracts isosurfaces via a geometry shader that applies real-time, user-driven Gaussian deformation to mesh vertices.
